name: tactics
notes: DESIGN §7.5 tactics suite (>= 60). Every case is a position in which the side to move can remove an enemy unit worth at least 800 cc within one macro turn. `best` is the COMPLETE set of end-position Kpos in which that unit is off the board, enumerated exhaustively with the M5 replica (src/ai/hard/core/state.ts) over one-action MOVEs, so `avoid` is deliberately empty: every end position outside `best` already fails the §7.5 rule. Kpos values are "0x" + src/ai/hard/verify/perft.ts kposHex (kposHi then kposLo, 16 hex digits). Authored at M7; scored from M14.
